paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: BLEU comparison between original Consistency-CE model and ours proposed Consistency-Bi model for wait-1 testing under prefix-constrained decoding setting.
model_annotation: The plot compares the BLEU scores of two models—Consistency-CE and Consistency-Bi—under a prefix-constrained decoding setting for wait-1 testing, as a function of the length of the gold prefix. The x-axis, labeled "the length of gold prefix," ranges from 0 to 20 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU," ranges from 23 to 29 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 1. The Consistency-CE model is represented by a blue dashed line with open circle markers, while the Consistency-Bi model is shown as a solid orange line with filled square markers. For Consistency-Bi, the BLEU score starts at approximately 27.6 at a prefix length of 0, remains relatively stable around 27.8–28.0 up to a prefix length of 5, then gradually declines to about 24.0 at a prefix length of 20. For Consistency-CE, the BLEU score begins at approximately 24.5 at a prefix length of 0, dips to around 23.5 at length 2, then rises steadily to approximately 28.0 at a prefix length of 20. The two lines intersect near a prefix length of 12, where both models achieve a BLEU score of approximately 26.0.
